_comment: Frozen before any retrieval code (Phase 5). Changes after a held-out run are not allowed; changes after development runs must be committed before the held-out run.

structured.entities: names in the question that match a referent label in scope (LoCoMo speakers; rule-extracted referents)
structured.candidates: turns authored by or naming those entities, inside the question's time window when gupi.timeexpr reads one from the question relative to its date
structured.ranking: turns that are evidence for an extracted claim about the entity first, then newest first

hybrid.filter: restrict to the structured candidates when there are any, otherwise unrestricted

scope.longmemeval: the question's own history sessions, as of its question_date

metrics: recall@k (share of gold evidence units in the top k)
hit@k (any gold unit in the top k)

amendments.change: Rule extraction runs on LoCoMo only. On LongMemEval the structured retriever uses authorship and names only.
amendments.why: LongMemEval S has about 200,000 user/assistant turns (sessions are namespaced by content because 4,672 reused session ids differ in content or date); running the rule extractor over them would take over an hour at current speed and finds almost nothing in first/second-person chat.

amendments.change: LoCoMo turn text includes the shared image caption, as '[shared image: <caption>]', when the dataset gives one.
amendments.why: Some LoCoMo evidence is in image captions; the caption is part of the original data.

amendments.change: Add system hybrid-unfiltered: reciprocal rank fusion of keyword and embedding without the structured filter. The pre-registered hybrid is unchanged.
amendments.why: On development data the structured filter seemed to hurt on LoCoMo (hybrid 0.414 vs hybrid-unfiltered 0.444 recall@5); the extra system tests that on held-out data instead of changing the primary hybrid.

amendments.change: LongMemEval held-out: keyword and structured run on all 447 held-out questions; embedding, hybrid and hybrid-unfiltered run on the held-out questions with sha256(question_id) mod 10 == 1 (64 questions). LoCoMo held-out runs every system on all questions.
amendments.why: Compute only: the local model embeds about 7 long turns per second here, so all ~175,000 held-out turns would take about 7 hours. The subset is fixed by id rule before any held-out result is seen.
